## Featured Projects

## Project 1: Trauma Resource Institute Analytics Project

### Google Analytics + SEO + User Engagement Strategy

In this project, my team and I analyzed the Trauma Resource Institute's website using Google Analytics to understand user behavior, traffic sources, and engagement patterns. We identified key areas for improvement in SEO performance and developed a strategy to enhance user engagement. Our recommendations included optimizing content for relevant keywords, improving site navigation, and implementing targeted marketing campaigns to increase visibility and drive more traffic to the site.

## Project 2: Trauma Resource Institute Marketing Strategy Project

### Google Ads + Competitve Analysis + Customer Segmentation + Growth Strategy

In this project, we conducted a comprehensive competitive analysis of the Trauma Resource Institute's market landscape. We used Google Ads to identify effective advertising strategies and performed customer segmentation to understand the target audience better. Based on our findings, we developed a growth strategy that included targeted advertising campaigns, content marketing initiatives, and partnership opportunities to expand the institute's reach and increase engagement with their services.

## Project 3: Customer Satisfaction of Students Eating at Cal Poly Pomona Restaurants

### Customer Insights + Data Analysis + Strategic Recommendations

In this project we conducted a survey to evaluate the customer satisfaction of students eating at Cal Poly Pomona restaurants. We analyzed the data to identify trends and areas for improvement in the dining experience. Our findings highlighted key factors that influence student satisfaction, such as food quality, service speed, and menu variety. Based on our analysis, we provided recommendations to enhance the overall dining experience for students on campus.
